## Scope
- Org-level / repo-level:
- Repo(s):
- Branch(es):

## Change Description
What will be changed (settings and/or code)?

## Blast Radius
Who/what is impacted? What can break?

## Preconditions
What must be true before execution (2FA readiness, owners, secrets, approvals)?

## Execution Plan
Ordered, minimal steps. Include exact UI path or file path.

## Validation
How do we confirm the change is enforced (required checks, ruleset matches, workflow runs)?

## Rollback
How do we revert if it breaks production or blocks merges?

## Decision Needed (if any)
If this requires Shane’s decision, link the Decision Request issue.
